turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Overall, how would you sum up your experience so far?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Strong product, rough pricing pain as we scale, and latency that's fine for async content but not yet ready for real-time voice agents. We're staying, but watching the roadmap closely for both of those.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What would make you an advocate rather than just a satisfied customer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ship the low-latency streaming tier and a volume pricing plan, and we'd be actively recommending you to other teams in our network.
